confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief. Radio at 09:30 says scoop 6 (LH-06) is stopped at N574-15, but CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago and operational. Confirm whether LH-06 is actually running. Until then, move nothing for that place (CONFIRM-01).

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C512-10 (OT-5100, repaired on site, 3/4/5 h). That stope has only 238-102 = 136 t of broken ore left, worth about 58.6 oz at 13.4 g/t. Without a loan, the repaired LH-01 (LH514, 120 m, about 40.8 t/h) is back by 12:30, 13:30 or 14:30. In the low and likely cases it clears the 136 t by 17:00. In the high case it clears about 102 t, so the loss is about 34 t, or 14.6 oz. The only cheap lender is LH-08 (LH410, DS-N600-01, 0.5 oz/h). It would need about 0.7 h of travel from Norte to Central, would muck about 29 t/h, and would leave the heading for roughly 4-5 h. That costs about 2-2.5 oz of development value against an expected gain of 0-3 oz, so it does not pay. LH-09 costs 2 oz/h, so it is out. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00 (06:00 start plus 8 h). Reserves can only be activated with a loader from a stopped stope, and there is none. LH-06 is in a radio/CMMS conflict, so I am moving nothing for N574-15 and asking the area chief to confirm. Net: no moves, 0 oz.
